# Configuration Layers

Where each rule, skill, agent and hook is installed, and which layer wins when
two of them say different things. **More specific always wins:** a project's
`CLAUDE.md` overrides the global manifest, and `CLAUDE.local.md` overrides both.

Every setting these files hold is listed in the
[Configuration Reference](configuration-reference.md).
